Physical Carrier Type

  • CURIE: gmeow:PhysicalCarrierType
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/PhysicalCarrierType
  • Category: class
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/archaeological-evidence

The archaeological or cultural-heritage classification of a physical object that bears inscriptions, marks, or signs — a value vocabulary (individuals, never subclasses). Open-ended: new carrier kinds are minted as needed without ontology modification.

Structure

Subclass of: gufo:QualityValue

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:PhysicalCarrierType as a specialized kind of gufo:QualityValue. Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
